newsitem.title: UK: British Land falls on dilution fears.
newsitem.headline: British Land falls on dilution fears.

text.p: Shares in British Land Co Plc fell 14 pence to 569-1/2 amid earnings dilution fears which came to the fore after the company set a 300 million stg convertible bond, dealers said.
"There is fear of dilution," said one dealer.

British Land launched the convertible bond to mainly finance its current acquisition programme, including forward funding of additional office space at No. 1 Finsbury Avenue, London and extensions at a number of food superstores.
The balance will be used to refinance bank indebtness and for general purposes.
The bond was launched with a coupon indicated at 6.25-6.50 percent. The par-priced notes will be convertible at a premium indicated at 20-22 percent.
The issue is callable at any time from June 17, 2002.
